title: Tire Check & Seasonal Swap
subtitle: Pressure, tread, then rotate or swap — short steps, big visuals, safe calls.
tone: Calm safety mentor. Celebrate monthly pressure checks. Escalate bald/damaged tires clearly. Max 2 buttons. Trust every ~3 steps.

ux_rules.trust_reminder_default: If you're unsure at any point, stop and go to a shop — that's the smart call, not quitting.

prerequisites: For rotation/swap: jack, stands, torque wrench
parts_checklist: Optional TPMS sensors on new tires

adaptive_rules.coach_note: Rotate about every 5,000–8,000 miles unless the manual says otherwise.
Regular snow/ice? Winter tires beat all-seasons near freezing.
Heavier EVs/hybrids: keep PSI exact and watch inner shoulder wear.
Tow/dirt use: inspect all four, not just the fronts.
Staggered sizes often can't cross-rotate — a tire shop prevents wrong-axle mounts.
Wear bars, cords, sidewall bulge, or sidewall puncture = don't drive far.

visual_assets.alt: Gauge and tread tool by a tire
visual_assets.shot_description: Soft loop: gauge needle settle + tread tool dip.
Finger points at front/rear PSI on placard.
Green/yellow/red depth zones; wear bar = replace.
Even / over / under / alignment icons animate.
Icons: bulge / nail / wear bar → stop or continue.

steps.title: Tire check — quick safety win
steps.coach_encourage: Monthly pressure checks put you in the top tier of owners.
steps.description: Pressure → tread → then rotate or seasonal swap. Flat or bulge? We'll branch to help first.
steps.safety_warning: Bulge, cord, or rapid hiss — park safe, don't highway-drive.

steps.title: Damage triage
steps.coach_encourage: Stopping for a bad tire is courage, not inconvenience.
steps.description: Sidewall cut/bulge or cords: don't drive — tow/replace. Nail in tread: spare or plug decision in chat. Wear bars flush: shop tires soon.
steps.trust_nudge: If you're unsure, stop and go to a shop — that's the smart call, not quitting.

steps.title: Set cold pressure
steps.coach_encourage: Placard PSI beats sidewall 'max' every time.
steps.description: Cold tires. Door-jamb numbers for all four (+ spare). TPMS may need a short drive to clear.
steps.safety_warning: Underinflation overheats; overinflation wears the center.

variants.description: EV tip: wrong PSI shows up as range loss and inner wear — stick to the placard.

steps.title: Pressure coaching
steps.description: Placard is on the driver door jamb (sometimes fuel door). Still missing? Chat with year/make/model. TPMS on after correct PSI: drive 5–10 min or chat for relearn tips.

action_buttons.label: Ask coach in chat
action_buttons.payload: Help me find correct cold tire pressure / clear TPMS for my vehicle.

steps.title: Tread & damage scan
steps.coach_encourage: Two minutes here prevents a roadside story later.
steps.description: Measure the shallowest groove. Wear bars (~2/32") = plan replacement. Scan sidewalls for cracks, nails, bubbles.
steps.safety_warning: Exposed cord or sidewall bubble — do not drive.
steps.trust_nudge: If you're unsure about damage, stop and go to a shop — that's the smart call, not quitting.

steps.title: Low tread or damage
steps.coach_encourage: Catching this on the driveway beats catching it in rain.
steps.description: Near wear bars: shop tires. Unsafe damage: tow/replace. Photo helps me call it.

steps.title: What is wear telling us?
steps.coach_encourage: Patterns talk — you're learning to listen.
steps.description: Even = good. Both edges low ≈ underinflation. Center worn ≈ overinflation. One edge/cupping ≈ alignment.

action_buttons.label: Uneven — coach me
action_buttons.payload: My tire wear is uneven. Help me decide pressure vs alignment vs rotation.

steps.title: Rotate, swap, or shop mount?
steps.coach_encourage: Inspection-only is a complete win if that's today's goal.
steps.description: Pressure + inspect = DIY done. Rotation/seasonal wheel swap = DIY with stands + torque. New tires on rims = shop balancer.
steps.safety_warning: Wrong torque or mismatched sizes can destabilize the car.

variants.coach_encourage: Paying for mount/balance on stagger fitment is smart.

steps.title: Finish or book a mount?
steps.coach_encourage: Either choice keeps you moving safely.
steps.description: Inspection complete → log it. Need new tires mounted/balanced → shop.
steps.trust_nudge: If you're unsure about sizes or torque, stop and go to a shop — that's the smart call, not quitting.

steps.title: Rotate or swap the set
steps.coach_encourage: Mark positions before anything comes off — future you will thank you.
steps.description: Follow the manual pattern. Seasonal sets: keep each wheel marked. Torque to placard spec in a star after the car is down.
steps.safety_warning: Jack stands before wheels off. Re-torque after 25–50 miles.
steps.trust_nudge: If a lug or wheel is seized and you're unsure, stop and go to a shop — that's the smart call, not quitting.

action_buttons.label: Stuck lug / pattern help
action_buttons.payload: Tire work: stuck lug or unsure rotation pattern for my drivetrain. Help?

variants.description: AWD/4WD: keep tread depth matched across axles — big mismatches stress the transfer case.

steps.title: Store & log
steps.coach_encourage: Habit locked in — your future self has better grip.
steps.personalize: Next rotation reminder ~6,000 miles for your {{make}}.
steps.description: Bag off-season tires cool and dry. Log pressures, tread, mileage.

completion.title: Tires checked — grip unlocked
completion.coach_encourage: You just did something most drivers skip. Respect.
completion.description: Recheck pressures next month and after big temperature swings.

action_buttons.label: Noise / pull follow-up
action_buttons.payload: My car pulls or tires hum after the check. What next?

ui_spec.figma: Coach shell per oil_optimized. Tread GIF autoplays. Damage branch uses danger styling. Max 2 CTAs.
